findings.title: Eleven reported leads in the latest seven calendar days
findings.body: From 9–15 November, the Sole Trader Signups campaign spent NZ$959.12 for 11 Meta-reported leads and 7 registrations. The preceding seven days, 2–8 November, recorded 16 leads on NZ$828.88. The 15 November figures are partial-day and Meta may reattribute historical events; these are not verified customer activations.
